INSERT INTO images ( group_id, original_file_path, compressed_file_path, location, latitude, longitude, altitude, taken_at ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{originalFilePath}, #{compressedFilePath},
ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)
ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(0, 0), 4326)
, COALESCE(#{latitude}, 0), COALESCE(#{longitude}, 0), #{altitude}, #{takenAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT i.image_id, i.group_id, i.original_file_path, i.compressed_file_path, i.latitude, i.longitude, i.altitude, i.memo, i.taken_at::timestamp AS taken_at, i.created_at::timestamp AS created_at FROM images i INNER JOIN image_groups g ON g.group_id = i.group_id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND i.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY i.taken_at ASC, i.image_id ASC
